plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Music Performance (BFA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Select from MUSC 277 , MUSC 280 , MUSC 282 , MUSC 283 , MUSC 290 , MUSC 381 . 3 credits must be taken at the 300 level.
[grid1 fn3] Select from MUSC 245 , MUSC 253 , MUSC 254 , MUSC 255 , MUSC 256 , MUSC 270 , MUSC 271 , MUSC 272 , MUSC 273 , MUSC 353 , MUSC 354 , MUSC 355 , MUSC 356 , MUSC 370 , MUSC 371 , MUSC 372 , MUSC 373 , MUSC 375 . 3 credits must be taken at the 300 level.
[grid1 fn4] Select from MSTC 150 , MSTC 417 ; MUSC 200 , MUSC 221 , MUSC 222 , MUSC 224 , MUSC 225 , MUSC 226 , MUSC 241 , MUSC 242 , MUSC 243 , MUSC 244 , MUSC 246 , MUSC 323 , MUSC 327/AFST 327 , MUSC 424 ; PERF 328 .
[grid1 fn5] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. 9 hours must be 300-400 level courses.
